about_the_game:
NOTICE: Our game requires two controllers to play.
To play online, please use Steam remote play.

THE PURRFECT COMPETITION!

OVERCAT makes full-on competitive gaming accessible to beginners, boasting a system where being dramatically better or worse than your opponent leads to even more exciting matches!

Tired of skill diffing your friends in repetitive, predictable matches? OVERCAT is the game for you and all your friends!

MEOW MEOW MEOW MEOW MEOW MEOW MEOW!

OVERCAT features 15 different playable characters (5 of which are available in the demo), each with their own special ability! Find your main kitty-cat across a range of painted environments, while listening to an original soundtrack of nothing but bangers!

A BOSS FIGHT AGAINST YOUR FRIENDS!?

OVERCAT features a special mechanic to bring a unique twist to your typical fighter, where you can choose between two different power levels!

Play as an Overcat for a massive boost to your fighting power! Your friends won't stand a chance against your bonus abilities and health!

Or are you feeling cocky? Then choose Undercat instead - a weaker option that rewards double points for going against the odds!

What will you choose? And what will your opponent choose!?

Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3070
